page.description: Oracle Linux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: Oracle's RHEL-compatible distribution, free to download and use, with its own kernel build and update channels. DVD images for x86_64 and aarch64.
pros: RHEL 10 compatible, free to download and use.
Oracle's own kernel and update channels alongside the RHEL-compatible userland.
DVD images for x86_64 and aarch64.
cons: Oracle states ten years of support from GA but publishes no exact end date for OL10.
The release date here is the release-notes date (2026-08-10).
The DVD is 11 GB; the aarch64 image is 10.5 GB.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Oracle Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One path: the DVD ISO per architecture, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. Oracle states ten years of support from GA but publishes no exact end date for OL10.
